meta.name: git-master
meta.description: MUST USE whenever a task needs a commit or git-history investigation. Covers atomic commits, staging, commit-message style, rebase, squash, fixup/autosquash, blame, bisect, reflog, git log -S/-G, and questions like who wrote this or when was this added. Do not use for ordinary code edits unless the user asks for git work.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理 Git 提交与历史，自动生成规范提交
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要规范提交或排查 Git 历史
copy.tagline_en: Manage Git commits and history with automated commit messages
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to make clean commits or investigate Git history

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会识别你的Git操作请求并分四类处理：提交改动、改写历史、查历史、查状态。提交前会检查diff并拆分原子提交；改写历史前会做安全确认；查历史时用git log、blame等工具并给出证据。
howto.when: 当你要求提交代码、查看提交历史或调查某行代码的来历，以及改写历史（rebase、squash等）时触发。仅询问普通代码编辑不触发。

say.text: 帮我提交这些改动，提交信息按仓库风格写
say.note: Claude会暂存改动并按仓库历史风格生成提交

say.text: 查一下这行代码是哪个提交加的，谁改的
say.note: 会用git log -S或blame追查并给出证据

say.text: 把最近三个提交压缩成一个

howto.what_en: Claude classifies Git requests into commit, rebase, history, or status. It commits atomically with repo-style messages, safety-checks history rewrites, and answers history questions with git log/blame evidence.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to commit changes, investigate history (who/when/why changed something), or rewrite history (rebase, squash). Ordinary code edits without a Git request do not trigger it.

say_en.text: Commit these changes with the message style from the repo history.
Find which commit added this line and who did it.
say_en.note: Uses git log -S or blame with evidence.

say_en.text: Squash the last three commits into one.
say_en.note: Runs interactive rebase to combine them.
